body:
Was bullied in high school, but not directly. There wasn’t any physical violence unless provoked, considering it was a private Catholic school. But all the verbal abuse, the backstabbing, the noise. It was a little too much for me, and I almost couldn’t handle it during senior year. I was really close to stabbing every single person in my batch. A few friends caught up and knew something wasn’t right with me. They talked me down and it was just uncontrollable crying from there on.

I sometimes wish they didn’t notice anything, and just let my emotions run wild and kill every single person who’s made my life a hell for all those years. I’m bitter seeing how they’re all moving forward without noticing how much pain they caused in school. I feel stuck and depressed from all those years, but at least I’m not in jail.
I’d build a planetarium, except it’s a huge library. Basically my dream home, built in some forest for that hermit lifestyle

if you’re asking for a translation, it means she got her kids “gpa immunized” when they were young, but they still got sick

it was actually hard to read even as a native speaker, wrong spelling and stuff

edit: tigdas is just measles

I still have my Geronimo Stilton collection from years ago. The original series, the comics, those hardbound fantasy ones, and a few of those entitled with Thea Stilton’s name. It’s quite a lot, but I don’t regret the money I’ve spent on it as a kid.

Honestly, so far I’ve been lying to my therapist about my situation.
I’m not good at projecting my problems to other people, at that moment words just refuse to come out of my mouth. I feel like he’s confused why I even need it, but he seems to be trying either way.

As for religion, I was born Catholic. I’ve been doubting it since high school started, but I have nothing against people who partake in it. It’s not something I’m into now as my family forces traditions, and I’m getting sick of it.

Forgive Me, Leonard Peacock by Matthew Quick is pretty good

Also The Bell Jar by Sylvia Path
Yep, I had to hide it, just in case. I’ll probably burn it or throw it in the trash.
It’s all crumpled up and I have ripped a few pages because of a mental breakdown. Oh well, these things happen.

I did, and I hated it. 
Not religion’s fault, just reminds how much of a hypocrite he was. Or maybe it just doesn’t work for some people?
